description: This file defines a wizard interface for recording and stopping module recording in OpenERP, including XML form definitions and control logic.

classes.name: base_module_publish
classes.description: Wizard interface class managing recording states and user interactions.

methods.name: _stop_recording
methods.description: Stops the module recording by setting 'recording' to 0.

methods.name: _start_recording
methods.description: Starts the module recording by setting 'recording' to 1 and resetting data if not continuing.

methods.name: _check_recording
methods.description: Checks if recording is active and determines next state ('stop' or 'start').
